summary: Iteration 2 validated the 4 new features on Zero Sprechi Chef. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed including new fields shopping_list/scrap_tip/diet plus regression (root, 400 on empty, disclaimer, no _id, vegan exclusion). Frontend Playwright: recipe generation renders Recupero Bucce & Scarti card, Condividi copies to clipboard and shows success toast, Esporta PDF opens a new tab, /preferiti search shows favorites-no-results on unmatched query, diet chip filter narrows to matching diet, diet badge visible on cards, detail modal opens with RecipeCard, and delete favorite works. Lista della Spesa card did not render on this specific generation because Gemini returned an empty shopping_list for 'un limone' + basic pantry (legitimate empty case, backend field verified present via pytest with minimal ingredients).

integration_issues.flow: Save second consecutive recipe after regenerating with different diet
integration_issues.issue: After saving recipe #1 and generating a new one, only 1 favorite ended up persisted (expected 2). Save button may reflect parent isSaved state that isn't reset when a new recipe is generated. Worth main-agent verification in Home.jsx (ensure isSaved resets on new recipe id).

action_items: Investigate whether Home.jsx resets the 'isSaved' state when a new recipe is generated so users can save consecutive recipes without page reload.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes _id from response (spreads doc after insert). New fields shopping_list/scrap_tip/diet are declared with sensible defaults and safe-parsed with str() coercion. LGTM.
share.js printRecipe escapes with a minimal HTML escaper (& < >) but doesn't escape quotes; safe here since values are used only as text nodes, not attributes.
Favorites filter uses useMemo with proper deps; diet badge is conditional on r.diet which is now populated by backend echo — good.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (10/11 assertions; shopping-list card not shown due to legitimate empty AI response, save-second-recipe not persisted)

seed_data_creation: Two live Gemini generations during frontend test; favorites in LocalStorage cleared by delete step.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now covers 9 tests including scrap_tip non-empty, diet echoed, shopping_list only-missing-items with minimal input. Use timeout>=180s for Gemini. Frontend selectors verified: recipe-scrap-tip, recipe-shopping-list, shopping-list-item, share-recipe-button (copies to clipboard, toast 'Ricetta copiata negli appunti!'), export-pdf-button (opens about:blank new tab with print HTML), favorites-search-input, favorites-diet-filter, favorites-diet-<slug>, favorites-no-results, diet badge inside favorite-recipe-item. To test the Lista della Spesa card render, may need to retry generation or use very sparse ingredients.
